newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Aminex says progress seen in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Aminex says progress seen in 1997.

text.p: Irish exploration group Aminex said on Wednesday that the outlook for 1997 looked promising.
"I look forward to considerable progress being made across the Company during the current year." chairman Peter Elwes told shareholders at an annual meeting.
Elwes said 1996 was a successful year for the Company with solid progress being made on a number of fronts.

"This progress has been sustained into 1997 with the Russian and U.S. production continuing to provide an important income stream and, the El Biban development in Tunisia poised to contribute cash flow later in the year," he said.
